source:
def consume(value, extra)
 p [value, extra, yield]
end
consume Hash[:a, 1], 42 do
 :callback
end

expected.message: Prefer literal hash to Hash[arg1, arg2, ...].

corrected:
def consume(value, extra)
 p [value, extra, yield]
end
consume({:a => 1}, 42) do
 :callback
end

expected.message: Prefer literal hash to Hash[key: value, ...].
Prefer literal hash to Hash[arg1, arg2, ...].

reason: Pinned Ruby attaches a block to a hash literal and generates invalid Ruby; keep the diagnostic without correction.
